name: Ma Furu Yoru no Rin
source: Akito, a normal but perverted student accidentally got dragged into a fight between demons and a beautiful demon hunter, Rin. During the fight, Akito tried to protect Rin from a fatal attack and became infected with a demonic virus. He was destined to become another demon, unless he survives 7 days without an excessive accumulation of negative emotions and abstains from using his demonic powers as much as possible. To help Akito, Rin decided to watch over him for 7 days, and if he fails to keep his humanity in check, Rin will kill him himself. Not wanting to get killed, Akito decided to seduce Rin and make her his woman.
translation: 普通但好色的学生秋人意外被卷入了恶魔和美丽的恶魔猎人凜之间的战斗。在战斗中，秋人试图保护凜免受致命攻击，却感染了恶魔病毒。除非他能在7天内存活下来，不过度积累负面情绪，并尽可能不使用恶魔之力，否则他注定会变成另一只恶魔。为了帮助秋人，凜决定守护他7天，如果他无法保持人性，凜将亲手杀了他。不想被杀的秋人决定诱惑凜，把她变成自己的女人。
